nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Shared formatting and styling helpers (date/time/currency formatting, type colors, icons, mood emoji, type guards) used across the daily-view card components.

nodes.name: formatTime
nodes.summary: Formats a time value for display in the daily view.

nodes.name: formatDate
nodes.summary: Formats a date value for display in the daily view.

nodes.name: formatDuration
nodes.summary: Formats a duration in minutes as a human-readable string.

nodes.name: formatCurrency
nodes.summary: Formats a monetary amount with its currency code for display.

nodes.name: getTimezoneAbbr
nodes.summary: Derives a short timezone abbreviation string for a given IANA timezone.

nodes.name: getTypeColors
nodes.summary: Returns Tailwind color classes for a given entity/timeline item type used for card styling.

nodes.name: getTransportationIcon
nodes.summary: Returns the icon identifier/emoji for a given transportation type.

nodes.name: getLodgingIcon
nodes.summary: Returns the icon identifier/emoji for a given lodging type.

nodes.name: getActivityIcon
nodes.summary: Returns the icon identifier/emoji for a given activity category.

nodes.name: getMoodEmoji
nodes.summary: Returns the emoji representing a given journal entry mood.

nodes.name: OfflineDownloadButton.tsx
nodes.summary: Button that triggers and shows progress for downloading a trip's data/photos for offline PWA use, opening the OfflineDownloadModal.

nodes.name: OfflineDownloadButton
nodes.summary: Renders a button that opens the offline download modal and reflects current download progress/state.

nodes.name: OfflineDownloadModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Modal that walks the user through selecting content and downloading a trip for offline access, tracking progress via the offline download service.

nodes.name: OfflineDownloadModal
nodes.summary: Guides the user through selecting trip content and downloading it for offline use, tracking and displaying progress from the offline download service.

nodes.name: OfflineStatusBadge.tsx
nodes.summary: Badge indicating whether a trip is available offline, its download progress, and staleness, backed by the offline download service.

nodes.name: OfflineStatusBadge
nodes.summary: Shows whether a trip is downloaded for offline use, its freshness/staleness, and current sync/download progress.

nodes.name: DayHeader.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the header for a day section in the timeline, including date, weather badge, and sunrise/sunset badge.

nodes.name: WeatherBadge
nodes.summary: Renders a compact badge summarizing the day's weather icon and temperature.

nodes.name: formatTimeInTimezone
nodes.summary: Formats a time value for display in a specified IANA timezone.

nodes.name: SunriseSunsetBadge
nodes.summary: Renders a badge showing sunrise and sunset times for the day.

nodes.name: DayHeader
nodes.summary: Renders the timeline day-section header combining the date, weather badge and sunrise/sunset badge.

nodes.name: MobileTimezoneToggle.tsx
nodes.summary: Small mobile-only toggle switching the timeline display between the trip's timezone and the user's local timezone.

nodes.name: MobileTimezoneToggle
nodes.summary: Renders a mobile-only toggle switching timeline display between trip and local timezones.

nodes.name: PrintMiniMap.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a small static map or route map for print output within the printable itinerary.

nodes.name: PrintMiniMap
nodes.summary: Renders a small static map centered on a single location for print output.

nodes.name: PrintRouteMap
nodes.summary: Renders a small static route map showing a path between multiple points for print output.

nodes.name: PrintableItinerary.tsx
nodes.summary: Print-optimized rendering of the full trip itinerary across all days, including activities, transportation, lodging, journal and unscheduled items, for PDF/print export.

nodes.name: formatTime
nodes.summary: Formats a time-of-day string for the printable itinerary.

nodes.name: formatDateHeader
nodes.summary: Formats a date as a section header string for the printable itinerary.

nodes.name: formatCost
nodes.summary: Formats a monetary amount with currency for the printable itinerary.

nodes.name: getTransportTypeName
nodes.summary: Maps a transportation type code to a human-readable label for print output.

nodes.name: getLodgingTypeName
nodes.summary: Maps a lodging type code to a human-readable label for print output.

nodes.name: ActivityItem
nodes.summary: Renders a single activity row in the printable full-trip itinerary.

nodes.name: TransportationItem
nodes.summary: Renders a single transportation-leg row in the printable full-trip itinerary.

nodes.name: LodgingItem
nodes.summary: Renders a single lodging row in the printable full-trip itinerary.

nodes.name: JournalItem
nodes.summary: Renders a single journal-entry row in the printable full-trip itinerary.

nodes.name: TimelineItemRow
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the type-specific print item renderer based on the timeline item's type.

nodes.name: UnscheduledActivityItem
nodes.summary: Renders an unscheduled activity row in the printable full-trip itinerary.

nodes.name: UnscheduledTransportationItem
nodes.summary: Renders an unscheduled transportation row in the printable full-trip itinerary.

nodes.name: UnscheduledLodgingItem
nodes.summary: Renders an unscheduled lodging row in the printable full-trip itinerary.

nodes.name: TimelineDaySection.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders one day's section within the chronological timeline view, including header, event cards, mini-map, and unscheduled activities.

nodes.name: mapTimelineTypeToEntityType
nodes.summary: Converts a timeline item's type into the corresponding entity-link entity type.

nodes.name: TimelineDaySection
nodes.summary: Renders one day's header, mini-map, event cards and unscheduled activities within the chronological timeline view.

nodes.name: TimelineEventCard.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders an individual timeline event (activity, transportation, lodging, journal) card with linked entities, photo preview, edit/delete/link actions, and nested child-activity rendering.

nodes.name: TimelineEventCard
nodes.summary: Renders a single timeline event card with icon, details, linked entities, photo preview, and edit/delete/link actions.

nodes.name: renderChildActivities
nodes.summary: Renders nested child activity rows beneath a parent activity's timeline event card.

nodes.name: TimelineFilters.tsx
nodes.summary: Filter controls (type toggles, view-mode switch, print dropdown) for the timeline view.

nodes.name: TimelineFilters
nodes.summary: Renders type-visibility toggles and a view-mode switch controlling which timeline items are shown.

nodes.name: PrintDropdown
nodes.summary: Renders a dropdown menu offering print options (full itinerary vs. current day) for the timeline.

nodes.name: UnscheduledActivityCard.tsx
nodes.summary: Compact card rendering an activity without a fixed date/time in the unscheduled-activities section of the timeline.

nodes.name: UnscheduledActivityCard
nodes.summary: Renders a compact card for an activity that has no fixed date/time.

nodes.name: icons.tsx
nodes.summary: Library of small inline SVG icon components (activity, journal, lodging, transport modes, edit/delete/link, chevrons, status icons) used throughout the timeline UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Each icon is a tiny stateless functional component wrapping inline SVG markup; modeled as a single cohesive icon set rather than as individual function nodes.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the public timeline components (day section, header, event card, filters, printable itinerary, etc.) for simpler imports elsewhere in the app.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript type definitions for timeline items, combining activity, lodging, transportation, journal and weather types into a unified timeline item shape.
